category_description: KiwiSaver, the government contribution and New Zealand Superannuation.
subcategory_description: Who can get New Zealand Superannuation, what it pays and how to apply.
label: NZ Super, single, living alone, before tax (fortnightly)
context: Paid fortnightly to a single person who lives alone or with a dependent child. Rates rise each year on 1 April in line with average wage changes.

label: NZ Super, single, sharing a home, before tax (fortnightly)
context: Paid fortnightly to a single person who lives with someone aged 18 or older (unless a dependent child of 18), or with a visitor staying more than 13 weeks in any 26-week period.

label: NZ Super, with a partner, before tax (fortnightly, each)
context: Paid fortnightly to each person where both partners qualify. The same amount is paid where only one partner qualifies.

label: NZ Super age of eligibility
context: A person must be 65 or older, be a citizen, permanent resident or hold a residence class visa, be ordinarily resident when they apply, and have lived in New Zealand for the required years.

subject_intro: Who can get New Zealand Superannuation, the fortnightly rates, how long a person must have lived in New Zealand and how to apply.
subject_meta_description: NZ Super is for people {fact:nz_super_age} old or over. See the {tax_year} fortnightly rates, from {fact:nz_super_couple} before tax, plus the residence rules and how to apply.
